# Fixtures

**Every file here is synthetic.** They were generated by the built-in fake ELM327
(`mini-obd fixtures`) on a virtual clock. They exercise the software; they do not
reproduce measurements from a real MINI, Porsche or any other vehicle. Each file's
first line says so (`"synthetic": true`), none contains a VIN, and sessions created
from them are labelled SYNTHETIC everywhere.

| File | Vehicle profile | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| healthy-idle.jsonl | MINI | steady idle, no DTCs |
| rough-idle.jsonl | MINI | intermittent RPM oscillation with coincident MAF / MAP / rail changes, pending P0101 |
| egr-airflow-mismatch.jsonl | MINI | sustained generic EGR-error PID, stored P0401, freeze frame |
| dpf-dtc-history.jsonl | MINI | stored / pending / permanent DPF-family DTCs, freeze frame, raw-only DPF PIDs |
| wifi-disconnect.jsonl | MINI | adapter drops the TCP connection repeatedly |
| unsupported-pids.jsonl | MINI | minimal PID set, missing services, negative responses |
| slow-adapter.jsonl | MINI | 250-600 ms responses, low sample rate |
| porsche-healthy-idle.jsonl | Porsche | petrol flat-six over K-line (ISO 9141-2) |
| porsche-bank-imbalance.jsonl | Porsche | diverging long-term fuel trims, pending P0174 |
| mini-monitoring-shutdown-fan.jsonl | MINI | `mini_extended_monitoring`: idle, engine stop, ECU goes silent, adapter voltage only; manual fan_running / ignition_off / fan_stopped markers |
| mini-monitoring-air-path.jsonl | MINI | `mini_extended_monitoring`: anonymised stand-in for the first real recording: cold start, stored P115D + MIL, MAF 0 / < 1 g/s spells while running, EGR-error swings, `unusual_engine_noise` / `rough_idle` markers, ECU lost at the end without a measured stop |

Format: `mini-obd-transcript/1` (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Replay with
`mini-obd replay fixtures/rough-idle.jsonl`. A real session exported from the tool
(`transcript.jsonl` inside the ZIP) uses the same format and replays the same way.
